table.description: One caseload statistics table of the federal courts as its Excel file (bankruptcy filings F-2, F-5A; Statistical Tables for the Federal Judiciary; Federal Judicial Caseload Statistics; Judicial Business), by circuit and district. Default: every line numbered (row, col1...) to find the header lines; then header_lines names the columns.

file.desc: the file name without .xlsx as on the table's page, e.g. bf_f2_0930.2026 (bankruptcy filings, table F-2, 12 months to Sept 30, 2026) or stfj_b_630.2026

header_row.desc: one header line instead; 0 (default) returns every line numbered

carry.desc: which header lines span to the right over blank cells: top (default), all, none
